description: This file defines an abstract base class for checkpointing (Checkpointer) and two concrete implementations (SyncCheckpointer and AsyncCheckpointer) that handle saving and loading model state dictionaries for a machine learning framework, specifically PyTorch. It includes methods for asynchronous and synchronous checkpoint operations, resource management, and interfacing with checkpoint reader, writer, and staging components.

classes.name: Checkpointer
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the checkpointing API with methods for saving, loading, and closing checkpoints.

classes.name: SyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Synchronous implementation of Checkpointer for coordinating checkpoint save/load operations using blocking I/O.

classes.name: AsyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Asynchronous implementation of Checkpointer supporting staged and background saving with async operations.

methods.name: tuple[Future,Future]|None save( self, path: str, state_dict: STATE_DICT, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Abstract method to save a state dictionary to storage; implemented synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: STATE_DICT load( self, path: str, state_dict: STATE_DICT | None = None, *, default_map_location: Any = None, strict: bool = False, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Abstract method to load a state dictionary from storage; implemented synchronously.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to release resources associated with the checkpointer.

methods.name: SyncCheckpointer.save
methods.description: Saves a checkpoint synchronously using the provided writer.

methods.name: SyncCheckpointer.load
methods.description: Loads a checkpoint synchronously, raising errors for missing keys if strict is set.

methods.name: SyncCheckpointer.close
methods.description: Closes the synchronous checkpointer and releases resources.

methods.name: AsyncCheckpointer.save
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous save operation, staging the state and initiating background writing.

methods.name: AsyncCheckpointer.load
methods.description: Loads a checkpoint synchronously even in the async implementation, with strict key checking.

methods.name: AsyncCheckpointer.close
methods.description: Closes async resources such as staging area and process.
